versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the alibabacloud-migration-db-evaluation-collector Skill, providing a standardized workflow for Alibaba Cloud CMH (Rainmeter) database evaluation.
- Supports all key steps: download the collector, create and manage read-only collection accounts, run data collection, export and upload data for evaluation, and generate detailed evaluation reports.
- Enforces strict terminology and output formatting rules for all responses and generated reports.
- Covers the full evaluation and reporting process with detailed security and data integrity guidelines.
- Generates 11 core evaluation reports, including compatibility and risk assessment, for Oracle and other supported databases.
